slices.title: Work profile, work unit, work queue and work-type components in the one existing .djpkg package engine (ALM): export, dependency order, atomic import, idempotent upgrade, dependency-safe uninstall
slices.note: Registered per the owner. WP-35.S2 shipped a separate work-profile importer behind the same logical-key rules; this slice folds it into the module package engine (needs a package component enum change, so a schema lease) and must not create a competing engine.
slices.evidence: Work units, profiles and queues travel through the one package engine (release/export/analyze/execute/uninstall); portable logical keys only; atomic import in the engine transaction; idempotent re-import (checksum-equal = no-op); upgrade = one new version; dependency-safe uninstall that deactivates and retains history; old endpoints are thin callers of the shared service. work-components-package.e2e-spec 12 tests; mutations: writing outside the transaction fails the atomic test, defeating the checksum comparison fails the idempotence/upgrade/uninstall tests. KNOWN: customization-package-alm.e2e-spec "rolls the whole import back when the database refuses one component" fails here with HTTP_ERROR instead of PACKAGE_IMPORT_FAILED because the private Postgres cluster is WIN1252 and cannot store a UTF-8 arrow in the test data (environment; not re-run on an untouched tree). DECISIONS TAKEN (owner may reverse): an identical unowned local component is adopted, not reported as a conflict; uninstall deactivates rather than deletes. NO UI for addWorkComponents yet. | UTF-8 ALM rollback test: the earlier failure was the private cluster being WIN1252; on a UTF-8 database (CREATE DATABASE … ENCODING UTF8 TEMPLATE template0) customization-package-alm.e2e-spec passes 19/19. Decisions recorded in ADR-0031.
